problem_name: Forest Firefighting UAV Mission Planning Problem (UAV-Firefighting)
description: UAVs collaboratively execute forest firefighting missions, comprising reconnaissance, firefighting, and reinspection stages

first_half.content: Task permutation (a full permutation of 1~75, denoting task execution order)

second_half.content: UAV assignment, one-to-one with the task permutation; each gene is a UAV ID (1~16)
second_half.constraint: Must match the task type (reconnaissance/reinspection may only be assigned UAV1~4, firefighting may only be assigned UAV5~16)

task_constraints.sequence_constraint: All tasks follow the sequence constraint (reconnaissance → firefighting → reinspection)
task_constraints.time_window_constraint: Only firefighting tasks have time window constraints

operational_rules: Scout UAVs carry no firefighting ammunition and can only execute reconnaissance and reinspection tasks
When a fighter UAV executes a firefighting task, the ammunition consumed equals the fire point's HP (an integer in 1~3)
Before execution, it must be checked that remaining ammunition ≥ HP; otherwise the task fails
Each UAV's accumulated flight distance over all its assigned tasks must not exceed its maximum flight range; otherwise the UAV's route is invalid
After refilling, the UAV is located at the base and then flies from the base to the fire point to fight the fire
Before executing a firefighting task, a fighter UAV whose remaining ammunition < the current fire point's HP must first return to the base to refill

initial_protection_value.description: Represents the combined value of the surrounding forest, facilities, personnel, etc.

fire_hp.description: A firefighting task consumes HP_j water bombs, and the executing UAV must have remaining ammunition ≥ HP_j

task_definitions.name: reconnaissance
task_definitions.description: Confirms the fire situation; consumes no ammunition

task_definitions.name: firefighting
task_definitions.description: Consumes HP_j water bombs to extinguish the fire point

task_definitions.name: reinspection
task_definitions.description: Confirms the fire is extinguished; consumes no ammunition

tasks.task_coordinates: All three tasks share the fire point's coordinates (x_j, y_j, 0)

sequence_constraint.order: Reconnaissance must precede firefighting, and firefighting must precede reinspection
sequence_constraint.enforcement: This order is naturally guaranteed by the global task execution order (a wrong order causes the task to fail)

4_objective_function.formula: total reward = Σ(reward of all tasks) - Σ(cost of all tasks) - Σ(UAV flight cost)

task_reward.condition: The reward is earned only when all 3 tasks of a fire point are completed
task_reward.calculation: When all three tasks of fire point j are completed, the reward 3 × Vj × HP_j is earned
task_reward.explanation: Vj is the fire point's protection value (50~100) and HP_j is the fire's HP (1~3); different fire points yield different rewards according to their value and HP

delay_cost.condition: A linear penalty applies when a task's start time exceeds its time window

flight_cost.explanation: The cost coefficient is 3 per km of flight distance

total_flight_distance.calculation: Sum of travel distances between all tasks (including the distance from the initial position to the first task)

5_1_chromosome_representation.gene_description: Corresponds to the 75 tasks. Each gene is an integer in 1~75, the globally unique identifier (ID) of a task

task_id_encoding.rule: The three tasks of fire point j are ID=(j-1)*3+1 (reconnaissance), (j-1)*3+2 (firefighting), and (j-1)*3+3 (reinspection), in order

5_1_chromosome_representation.chromosome_type: Permutation: every task ID appears exactly once, without repetition
5_1_chromosome_representation.execution_order: The chromosome order defines the global task execution order: tasks earlier in the chromosome are executed first, later ones afterward

5_2_decoding_process.method: Process tasks in chromosome order; the UAV for each task is specified by the second half of the chromosome, then feasibility is verified and timings computed

steps.name: Initialization
details: Initialize all UAV states (position, current time, remaining ammunition, accumulated flight range)
Initialize each fire point's state (0=not started, 1=reconnaissance done, 2=firefighting done, 3=all three tasks succeeded)

steps.name: Task processing loop
steps.details: For each task ID in the chromosome (index i):

sub_steps.action: Fetch task info and the assigned UAV
sub_steps.details: Fetch the task's fire point number j and type t (1=reconnaissance, 2=firefighting, 3=reinspection); take the i-th gene of the chromosome's second half as assigned_uav
If the fire point's current state ≠ t-1, the task fails (sequence violation penalty +10) and is skipped
Check that the assigned_uav's type matches the task type (reconnaissance/reinspection require scout, firefighting requires fighter). A mismatch fails the task (penalty +10) and skips it

For firefighting tasks: if the assigned_uav's remaining ammunition < HP_j, check whether a round trip to the base to refill is possible. If the round trip exceeds the maximum flight range, the task fails (penalty +1) and is skipped

details: Flight distance d = Euclidean distance (UAV's current position → fire point position)
Flight time Δt = d / speed (0.5 km/s)
Arrival time t_arrive = UAV's current time + Δt
If a refill is needed: first fly to the base (distance dist_to_base, taking dist_to_base/speed), refill at the base (5.0 seconds), then fly to the fire point (distance dist_from_base)
feasibility_checks: For a firefighting task with t_arrive > end_j, record the delay cost (do not skip; penalize the delay only)
For a firefighting task with t_arrive < start_j, wait until start_j, i.e., start time = start_j; otherwise start time = t_arrive
Flight range check: if the UAV's accumulated range + d > maximum range, the UAV is infeasible (penalty +0.1) and the task is skipped

sub_steps.action: Execute the task and update states
updates: Update the UAV's position to the fire point position
Update the current time to the start time
Remaining ammunition (decrease by HP_j for firefighting tasks)
Increase the accumulated flight range by the flight distance
If a refill is needed, first update the flight range and time for the trip to the base and back, and reset ammunition to 3
Mark the task as successful and update the fire point state (reconnaissance→1, firefighting→2, reinspection→3)
When the fire point state becomes 3 (reinspection done), accumulate the fire point's reward 3×Vj×HP_j
For a firefighting task whose start time > end_j, record the delay cost

steps.name: Final computation
steps.details: After all tasks are processed, compute:
calculations: Total reward = sum of rewards over all successful fire points (each fire point's reward is 3×Vj×HP_j)
Total delay cost = max(0, start time - end_j) × 10 over all firefighting tasks
Total flight cost = sum of all UAVs' accumulated flight ranges × 3
Constraint violation penalty = number of constraint violations × 1000
Fitness (objective value) = total reward - total delay cost - total flight cost - constraint violation penalty

points: The first half of the chromosome (75 genes) encodes the task execution order as a permutation of 1~75
The second half of the chromosome (75 genes) encodes the UAV assignment: each position gives the UAV ID assigned to the task at the same index
During decoding, tasks are processed in order; a task fails with a penalty upon a sequence violation (type mismatch), UAV type mismatch, insufficient ammunition, or insufficient flight range
Firefighting tasks tolerate late arrival (penalized but not skipped), while reconnaissance and reinspection tasks have no time window constraints
Mutation operators: swap/insert/inversion may be applied to the task order part, while 1~3 positions of the UAV assignment part may be randomly reassigned

functions: After refilling, the UAV's position becomes the base coordinates
